design_vision: Create a warm, lively, and empathetic visual experience. The colors need to be more vivid while retaining the organic warmth required for a caregiving non-profit. Background images must be clearly visible in every section, giving depth and context without sacrificing readability. The layout should feel spacious, human-centric, and premium.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold

section_backgrounds.rule: Every major section must have a visible background image. Use full-width relative containers with a background image layer, covered by an absolute inset-0 color overlay (e.g., bg-[#FBF9F6]/85 or bg-white/80) to ensure text contrast while letting the image show through clearly. Ensure all text and foreground elements have relative z-10.

className="relative overflow-hidden" ...
...

cards.style: Neumorphic tactile or Solid card with subtle shadow. Background pure white #FFFFFF, rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl, shadow-lg, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300.

hero.overlay: bg-black/40 to ensure the hero image is visible but the white text on top is 100% readable. Use a gradient overlay if necessary: bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-black/20
hero.alignment: Center-aligned for maximum emotional impact, or left-aligned with a bento grid showcasing statistics or core values.

buttons.primary: bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-secondary-dark rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold shadow-md transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all

hero.description: Nurse smiling with elderly patient in a warm, bright room

home_respite.description: Nurse helping patient at home warmly

about.description: Seniors talking and smiling together warmly

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the vivid color palette carefully: Primary green for structure and calm, Secondary orange for CTAs and warmth.

Implement the background image overlay strategy strictly on every major section (e.g., Services, About, Regions, Contact) so that imagery is visible behind the content. Use bg-[url(...)] with a bg-[#FBF9F6]/85 absolute overlay.
Replace the 'Organisme à but non lucratif' mention in the hero section with 'Au service des personnes vulnérables'.
Replace the dull photos with the new warm, smiling, and lively images provided in the media section.
Maintain the existing Regions section photos as they are.
Ensure all interactive components and key text fields include 'data-testid' attributes for testing.
